tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Search live pre-owned golf club inventory by keyword, category (Drivers, Fairway Woods, Hybrids, Irons, Wedges, Putters, Golf Sets), brand, shaft flex (Regular, Stiff, Senior / Lite, Extra Stiff, Ladies), dexterity (Right Handed, Left Handed), price range, and showroom branch (Pretoria or Cape Town)

tools.name: get_club_details
tools.description: Fetch detailed specifications for a specific golf club: loft, shaft model, grip condition, detailed condition score (e.g. 8/10 - Very Good), showroom location, high-resolution photo gallery URLs, live price, and product page URL.

tools.name: get_ai_caddy_recommendation
tools.description: Provide personalized golf club recommendations and expert caddy advice based on golfer handicap, swing speed, typical shot miss/fault (slice, hook, low launch), target club type, and budget.

tools.name: estimate_trade_in_value
tools.description: Calculate an instant valuation estimate for a customer looking to trade in or sell their used golf clubs to WeBuyClubz, including estimated cash payout and +15% store credit bonus.

tools.name: create_cart_checkout
tools.description: Build a shopping cart session with selected items and generate a secure 1-click checkout link (preloaded into the WeBuyClubz cart drawer with instant Yoco / Payflex checkout).

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Retrieve store operating hours, physical showroom addresses in Pretoria (Equestria) & Cape Town (Brackenfell), nationwide courier rates, payment options, and customer guarantees.

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Securely check customer order status, payment state, fulfillment progress, and courier tracking details by order ID/number and matching customer email or phone.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_club_details, check_order_status · Public sink: check_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_club_details, check_order_status · Public sink: check_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
